svg.text: LESSON GUIDE: MULTI-DIGIT ADDITION & DECIMAL REGROUPING
Step-by-Step Hands-On Tutorial: 347 + 285 = 632 with Regrouping Tokens
SERIES 1 • CARD 12 OF 12 • DOMAIN: POSITIONAL BASE-10 & REGROUPING

g.text: Place 347 in top row (White) and 285 in
Place the Red token on the Tens column
3. REGROUP TENS: 4 + 8 + 1 = 13. Trade 10 tens for a Red (+1) in Hundreds.
4. READ COMPLETED SUM: Keep 3 in Tens; Hundreds: 3 + 2 + 1 = 6. Total = 632!
CORE PRINCIPLE: CARRYING IS PHYSICAL TRADING
In standard algorithms, carrying is a mysterious tiny 1 written above a column.
Here, carrying is a physical trade: 10 units become 1 ten block.
Students see that value is conserved across columns!
Set up Decimal tray with 1.75 and 0.85. Regroup hundredths and tenths. What is the sum?
